summary: Phase 3 (Community & Social) verified end-to-end. Backend Prayer Journal endpoints — POST /api/community/prayers (create with is_mine=true, pray_count=0), GET list, POST /pray toggle (1↔0), anonymous author=null, DELETE by author 200, DELETE non-existent 404, empty body 400, 401 without token — all pass (9/9 pytest). Frontend on mobile viewport (390x844) with token 'test_feat_aug25': Community tab shows community-prayers-banner and navigates to /community/prayers (prayer-journal-screen). Composer submit adds intention at top; prayer-pray-<id> toggles to 'Prayed · 1' and back to 'I prayed'; prayer-delete-<id> removes own post (window.confirm auto-accepted); anonymous toggle results in card labeled 'Anonymous'. Profile tab shows Friends section: profile-friends-list rendered (1 accepted friend for test user); profile-friends-manage navigates to /community/people; profile-friend-<userId> navigates to /community/user/[id]. No React Native red screens. Only harmless deprecation warnings on web ('shadow*' props, props.pointerEvents) which are expected in Expo web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py pray toggle uses a try/except-based approach (relies on unique index conflict for the OFF path). Works because community_prayer_prays has a unique compound index on (prayer_id,user_id), but broad `except Exception` also swallows unrelated failures (e.g. transient DB errors) as an 'off' toggle. Consider an explicit find→branch pattern for clarity.
PrayerIntentionRequest.body has no pydantic min/max; length trimming happens in community_svc.clean_body — fine, but adding max_length=1500 to the model would surface 422s earlier.
seed_data_creation: Test intentions created with body prefix 'TEST_' were programmatically cleaned up via DELETE at the end of the UI run; the pytest suite also deletes everything it created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 fully passed. Prayer Journal backend at /api/community/prayers (GET/POST, POST /{id}/pray, DELETE /{id}) is stable. Profile Friends section reads from friendList('accepted') / friendList('incoming'); test admin (philipwils13@gmail.com) currently has ≥1 accepted friend so the populated list branch is covered. Empty-state (profile-friends-empty) branch was not exercised in this run but is present in the code (line ~175 in profile.tsx).
